title: Japan's embassy in Uzbekistan suspends online visa appointment booking after repeated unauthorized access attempts, it says
date_note: The page gives only its publication day (24 November 2026, 10:12); no earlier suspension day is stated.
geo_basis: country as the source states it; the page does not name a city
summary: Podrobno.uz reports that the Embassy of Japan in Uzbekistan temporarily suspended its online visa appointment system after repeated unauthorized access attempts. The embassy says slots will reopen gradually once the system can be run securely and asked people not to log in unless necessary. Residence-certificate holders and people with a foreign-ministry note can request an appointment by email.
plain: Japan's embassy in Uzbekistan paused online visa booking, saying someone repeatedly tried to get into the system without permission. It will reopen slots gradually.
exec: Visa applicants to Japan in Uzbekistan cannot book online for now, according to the embassy as reported by Podrobno.uz.
action: The embassy asks people not to log in to the booking system unless absolutely necessary; certain applicants may email documents to request an appointment.

validation.note: Only Podrobno.uz (Russian), quoting the embassy, was read; the embassy's own notice was not found.
